settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Inventory must expose stable category/subcategory/setting/manager destinations plus source, scope, exposure, requested/effective, availability, restart/reconnect, and changed-elsewhere state.

schema_event_storage_impacts: Persistent demo proves revisioned local projections; production needs typed operation/receipt identity, redaction, idempotency, and last-known-good recovery.
Provider installation identity must remain separate from accounts/connections/entitlements/models.
Settings import/copy/reset and backup/restore require preview, conflict policy, verification, and rollback state.
migration_supersession_impacts: Retire old category chip/bloom/no-sidebar contract and adjudicate cmd.settings.bloom.open as compatibility alias only.
Retire stale right-panel language in favor of responsive inspector/drawer/inline evidence.
Do not revive regular/yolo mode coupling or invalid inventory values.
slint_port_impacts: Map manager/resource collections to Slint ListModel structures.
Keep DOM geometry and IntersectionObserver out of product state; port section-position and focus signals.
Translate semantic motion blueprints (including transaction/preview) to Slint timelines with reduced-motion parity.
Use lazy manager hydration and bounded list virtualization for low-memory targets.
unresolved_questions: Exact command IDs and aliases require canonical UI Command Catalog adjudication.
Exact settings inventory IDs and schema fields require owner audit; concept fixture IDs are not canon.
